name: topo-background
title: Topo Background
description: A drifting topographic map: contour lines traced through a noise terrain on a canvas, with a hill that rises under the cursor.

props.name: interval
props.description: Height difference between two contour lines. Lower draws more lines.

props.name: speed
props.description: How fast the terrain drifts. 0 holds it still.

props.name: interactive
props.description: Raise a hill under the cursor. Off on touch screens and under reduced motion.

props.name: seed
props.description: Seed for the terrain, so a page always opens on the same map.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes for the root element.
